blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10. The core of the solution is a single vision-language-action (VLA) model, one checkpoint for all 100 tasks, built on our 1st-place 2025 solution, which is based on $π_{0.5}$. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025, its Q rises from 0.260 to 0.371; across all 100 tasks it scores 0.392. Our main conclusion from 2025 was that the model was undertrained, so most of the 2026 work went into training the model for longer, optimizing some training parameters, making each training step slightly faster and reducing the gradient noise: a migration from 50 to 100 tasks (semantic stages built from the demonstrations' skill annotations, task and stage embeddings of new tasks warm-started from similar old ones, and a 21-dimensional action space matching the teleoperation controls); variance-reduced multi-sample flow matching with a simple noise-vs-compute model that picks the number of action-expert samples per observation without ablations; and a 200k-step training run, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. A cloud evaluation infrastructure keeps a shared record with provenance, episode diagnostics and restorable simulator states, and runs six simulators on one GPU together faster than real time. On top of the learned policy, 14 tasks are routed to a GPT-6 Astra coding agent that controls the robot through observation and motion tools, starting every episode from a frozen copy of its own practice session on training instances. Across these 14 tasks, Astra's mean Q is 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy. The public submission included only part of the Astra results and scored 0.446 Q with 27.3% full-task success.

blocks.en: 1.1  The 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
blocks.zh: 1.1 2026贝哈维尔 挑战

blocks.en: The BEHAVIOR Challenge [ 4 , 3 ] evaluates robot policies on long-horizon household activities in the OmniGibson simulator, built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The 2026 edition doubles the 2025 task set: 100 activities, from turning on a radio to cooking a meal, each with 200 teleoperated demonstrations (20,000 episodes, 211M frames or about 1,950 hours, in the LeRobot [ 6 ] format). The robot is the same Galaxea R1Pro: a holonomic base, a 4-joint torso and two 7-DOF arms with parallel grippers, observed through a head camera and two wrist cameras plus proprioception. An episode is a full success if all goal predicates are satisfied, which scores 1. Otherwise its q-score (we also call it Q) is the fraction of satisfied predicates. Scores are averaged over instances and then over tasks. The time limit of an episode is 1.5 × \times the mean duration of the human demonstrations of the task (2 × \times in 2025). The 50 tasks of 2025 are included with the same demonstrations; the other 50 are new.

blocks.en: 1.2  Vision-language-action models
blocks.zh: 1.2 愿景语言行动模式

blocks.en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) fine-tune a pretrained vision-language model to output robot actions [ 8 ] . The π 0 \pi_{0} family [ 9 , 10 ] pairs a PaliGemma VLM [ 15 ] with a smaller “action expert” trained by flow matching [ 18 ] to generate chunks of continuous actions, optionally co-trained with discrete FAST action tokens [ 12 ] . Many alternatives have appeared since, such as GR00T [ 13 ] and, increasingly prominent, MolmoAct2 [ 14 ] . Yet more than a year after its release (paper in April 2025, code and weights in September 2025 [ 11 ] ), π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} is still widely used as a base for fine-tuning: both top 2025 BEHAVIOR solutions were built on it [ 1 , 7 ] . We built our 2026 solution on top of our 2025 one, so we kept its π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} -based architecture. For this reason, in parts of this report we call our learned policy simply π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} .

blocks.en: 1.3  LLM agents as robot controllers
blocks.zh: 1.3 LLM 代理作为机器人控制器

blocks.en: A second line of work uses large language models to control robots directly: by choosing among learned skills [ 27 ] , writing control code [ 28 ] , or orchestrating a low-level policy. With frontier models that can use tools for hours, this has become a practical option in simulation. GPT-6 Astra [ 29 ] , released in September 2026, was strong enough to solve some BEHAVIOR tasks that our learned policy could not, so our final submission routes 14 tasks to an Astra-based agent (Section 9 ).

blocks.en: 1.4  Our starting point
blocks.zh: 1.4 (中文(简体) ). 我们的起点

blocks.en: Our 2025 solution [ 1 ] won the first BEHAVIOR Challenge. It took π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and changed the following: trainable task embeddings instead of text prompts, correlated noise for flow matching, a learnable mixture of all VLM layers’ keys and values for the action expert, a stage-prediction head with voting (“System 2”), a FAST auxiliary loss, several flow samples per VLM forward pass, and correlation-aware inpainting at inference. The 2025 checkpoints were clearly undertrained: the loss was still falling when the deadline came, and four checkpoints split the 50 tasks between them. The LeHome Challenge solution [ 2 ] of one of our team members was built on top of the 2025 BEHAVIOR solution and introduced several engineering fixes and improvements that we inherit here as well. The 2025 runner-up [ 7 ] also starts from π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and studies the effect of image resolution, of the training data and of rejection-sampling fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 2.1  What carries over
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 背着什么

blocks.en: From our 2025 solution we keep the model and most of the serving logic [ 1 ] : • Task embeddings instead of text: each task has a learned embedding, and the prompt is never tokenized. • System 2 stages : the model predicts the current stage of the task from the base task token and is conditioned on a stage embedding; at inference the stage is tracked by voting. • Correlated flow noise : the flow-matching noise has the covariance Σ β = β ​ C + ( 1 − β ) ​ I \Sigma_{\beta}=\beta C+(1-\beta)I ( β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 ), where C C is the empirical correlation of normalized action chunks, both in training and at inference. • KV mixing : each action-expert layer attends to a learnable mixture of the keys and values of all VLM layers. • Multi-sample flow matching : the VLM prefix is computed once, and the action expert is run for K K flow samples (Section 5 ). • FAST auxiliary loss : the VLM also predicts the FAST tokens of the target chunk during training. • Correlation-aware inpainting at inference: the actions already committed from the previous chunk anchor the next one, and the action correlations carry the correction over to the free actions.

blocks.en: 2.2  Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 型号

blocks.en: Figure 1 : The 2026 model. The VLM (left) encodes three camera images, register and scratch tokens, the task and stage embeddings and the robot state; the smaller action expert (right) denoises a 30-step action chunk and reads the VLM through a learnable mixture of the keys and values of all VLM layers. The task and stage embeddings also enter the expert directly through two conditioning tokens. Every attention layer of both transformers has a learnable sink. FAST tokens are used only in training.

blocks.en: 3  Migration from 50 to 100 Tasks
blocks.zh: 3 从50个任务转移到100个任务

blocks.en: The 2025 solution served four checkpoints, each fine-tuned on a subset of the 50 tasks. In 2026 one checkpoint serves all 100 tasks. It is warm-started from the 2025 checkpoint that carried the largest share of the 2025 score; a single conversion script maps it to the new task set, stage layout and action space. All parameters added in 2026 are zero-, identity- or small-normal-initialized, so the converted model starts close to the 2025 function.
blocks.zh: 2025年的解决办法为4个检查站服务,每个检查站都根据50项任务中的一部分进行了微调。 2026年,有一个检查站负责所有100个任务。 它是从2025年检查站开始的,该检查站承担了2025年分数的最大份额;一个单一的转换脚本将其映射到新的任务设置,舞台布局和行动空间. 2026年所增加的所有参数均为零,身份-或小-正常-初始化,因此被转换的模型开始接近2025函数.

blocks.en: 3.1  Semantic stages
blocks.zh: 3.1 语义阶段

blocks.en: In 2025 the System 2 stages were equal slices of each episode in time (5–15 per task), because we did not use the skill annotations. With 20,000 annotated demonstrations we could check how well these time slices match the actual steps of the tasks, and they match poorly. On average only 50% of the frames of a time stage belong to its most common annotated step (0.17–0.82 per task); 57% of the 1,093 time stages of the 100 tasks have no step that covers more than half of their frames; and the borders of the time stages are no closer to the real step borders than random borders would be. Episode lengths within a task vary by 20%, so in an 11-stage task a fixed time grid can be off by about two stages in either direction.
blocks.zh: 在2025年,系统2阶段是每集的平分时间(每集5至15个),因为我们没有使用技能说明。 有了2万个附加说明的演示,我们就可以检查这些时间切片与任务的实际步骤相匹配的程度,它们也非常不匹配. 平均来说,一个时间阶段的50%的框架属于它最常用的附加说明的步骤(0.17–0.82个任务);100个任务中的1 093个时间阶段中,57%没有超过一半的框架的步骤;而时间阶段的边界与真正的步骤边界相去甚远,而不是随机边界。 任务内部的平面长度相差20%,因此在11个阶段的任务中,固定的时间网格可以在两个方向的大约两个阶段关闭.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Semantic stages (colors) of 24 demonstrations of make_microwave_popcorn against the five equal-time stages used in 2025 (dashed). Each row is one demonstration; the white gap at the end is the idle tail after task completion.
blocks.zh: 图3:针对2025年使用的5个平时阶段(dashed),24个make_microwave_popcorn的语义阶段(颜色). 每行都是一出演示;结尾的白缺口是任务完成后闲置的尾巴.

blocks.en: We replaced them with semantic stages built from the annotations (Figure 3 ): 1. each episode is cut at the frame where the task is complete, and its sequence of annotated skills is aligned to the typical sequence of the task (the medoid); retries and extra steps are assigned to the current step; 2. the steps are grouped into stages at points where the demonstrations agree; parts that demonstrators do in varying order (e.g. sorting items) become order-free progress stages; 3. a few rules then adjust the grouping: a grasp and a press-type action (press, switch, toggle) are never in the same stage, so that the gripper rule (Appendix A ) can tell a missed grasp from a press; similar-looking states of the same appliance are kept in separate stages; repeated steps in a row become one stage; very short stages are merged into a neighbour unless they are a distinct final action. The result has 413 stages (2–9 per task) instead of 1,093 time stages. Every label is regenerated from the dataset annotations by deterministic scripts.
blocks.zh: 我们用注解中构建的语义阶段(图3)取而代之: 1. 每一集在任务完成的构架中被剪接,其附加注释的技巧序列与任务的典型顺序(medoid)一致;将回旋和附加步骤分配给目前的步骤;2. 步骤在示威活动同意时被分成几个阶段;示威者按不同顺序完成的部分(如分拣项目)成为无秩序的进步阶段;3. 少数规则然后调整分组:抓取和新闻类动作(press, switch, toggle)从未处于同一阶段,因此抓取规则(Appendix A)能够从报刊上显示错失的把握;类似类似器件的状态被保留在不同的阶段;一行中的重复步骤成为一个阶段;非常短的阶段被合并为邻居,除非它们是独特的最终行动. 结果分为413个阶段(每个任务2至9个阶段),而不是1 093个阶段。 每个标签都由数据集说明由定型脚本再生成.

blocks.zh: 每集在任务完成后的框架被剪切出来,其注释技能的序列与任务的典型序列(medoid)相接;复刻和额外步骤被分配到当前步骤;

blocks.en: 3.2  Warm-starting new tasks and stages
blocks.zh: 3.2 温暖地开始新的任务和阶段

blocks.en: Tasks. The 50 tasks of 2025 keep their trained embeddings. We could initialize the 50 new ones randomly, but many new tasks are similar to old ones, so instead each new task starts from a weighted average of the embeddings of 1–5 similar 2025 tasks (most have three), with weights 1 , 0.7 , 0.5 , 0.35 , 0.25 1,0.7,0.5,0.35,0.25 by rank. The average is rescaled to the average norm of its sources, because averaging makes vectors shorter. The similar tasks were proposed by a similarity search over task names, skills and object categories and then reviewed by hand and by Claude models. For example, freeze_fruit starts from freeze_pies , clearing_food_from_table_into_fridge and storing_food .
blocks.zh: 任务 2025年的50项任务保留了训练有素的嵌入. 我们可以随机初始化50个新任务,但许多新任务与旧任务相似,因此每个新任务从嵌入式1至5个类似2025年任务的加权平均值开始(多数有3个),加权为1分,0.7分,0.5分,0.35分,0.25分,0.7分,0.5分,0.35分,0.25分. 按等级划分。 平均值被调整到其来源的平均值上,因为平均值使矢量更短. 类似的任务是通过对任务名称、技能和对象类别进行相似性搜索而提出的,然后由手和克洛德模型审查。 例如, 冻果从冻后开始, 清除_ table_ into_fridge 并储存_ food 。

blocks.en: Stages. The same idea is used one level down. A semantic stage of an old task starts from the average of that task’s 2025 time-stage embeddings, weighted by how many of its frames fell into each time stage. A stage of a new task starts from the matching stages of similar old tasks (e.g. “open the fridge” from the old tasks that open a fridge). The output weights of the stage head are converted in the same way.
blocks.zh: 阶段。 同一想法被用在一个下级. 旧任务的一个语义阶段是从该任务2025年时间阶段嵌入的平均值开始的,按每个时间阶段有多少个框架进行了加权。 新任务的一个阶段是从类似旧任务(例如打开冰箱的旧任务“打开冰箱”)的相匹配阶段开始的。 舞台头部的输出重量以同样的方式转换.

blocks.en: 3.3  Minimal action space
blocks.zh: 3.3 最小行动空间

blocks.en: The 2025 model predicted 32 dimensions, of which 23 were real (base 3, torso 4, two arms of 7, two grippers). We changed the action representation to match the degrees of freedom used in teleoperation: • the 9 padding dimensions are gone; • the JoyLo teleoperation system [ 5 ] does not move the four torso joints independently. It has two torso controls: translate moves the torso along a fixed path through three key poses, from upright to fully bent down, and tilt adds an offset to the third joint; the fourth joint is always zero. Every torso command in the 211M frames of the dataset has exactly this form, and translate and tilt can be recovered exactly from the four joints. The model therefore predicts translate and tilt, and its outputs are mapped back to the four joints. The result is a 21-dim action and state space: [base 3, translate, tilt, left arm 7, left gripper, right arm 7, right gripper]. Four correlated, partly redundant torso dimensions became two meaningful ones, and the policy can no longer produce torso configurations the demonstrations never visit. The shared control space also lets a JoyLo operator smoothly take over from the policy during an episode. The weights of the remaining dimensions are copied, and the two new torso rows start at zero.
blocks.zh: 2025年的模型预测出32个维,其中23个是真实的(基座3,躯干4,双臂为7,双握手). 我们修改了动作表示方式,以与远程操作中使用的自由度相匹配: • 9个编程维度已去; • Joy Lo远程操作系统 [5] 不独立移动四个躯干关节. 它有两个躯干控制器:将躯干沿固定路径通过三个键形来移动,从正上向下到完全向下,而倾斜会给第三个关节增加一个抵消;第四个关节总是为零. 数据集211M帧中的每一个躯干指令都完全有这个形式,而翻译和倾斜可以完全从四个关节恢复. 因此,模型预测了翻译和倾斜,其输出被映射回了四个关节. 结果是21-dim动作和状态空间:[基座3,翻译,倾斜,左臂7,左握手,右臂7,右握手]. 四个相关、部分冗余的躯干维度成为两个有意义的维度,而且该政策无法再产生示威从未到过的躯干配置。 共享控制空间也让一个JoyLo操作员在一集中顺利地接管了政策. 剩余维度的权重被复制出,而两个新的躯干行从零开始.

blocks.zh: 9个接地的维度消失了;

Every torso command in the 211M frames of the dataset has exactly this form, and translate and tilt can be recovered exactly from the four joints. blocks.en: The same principle applies to the vocabulary: the model only ever embeds the 256 state bins (FAST tokens have their own embedding table), so we keep 256 of Gemma’s 257,152 embedding rows. This removes 526M parameters that received no gradient but were stored four times in every training checkpoint (weights, EMA and the two Adam moments): about 8 GB per checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 同样的原理也适用于词汇:模型只嵌入了256个状态的被子(FAST令牌有自己的嵌入表),所以我们保留了256个Gemma的257,152个嵌入行. 这移除了526M参数,这些参数没有获得梯度,而是被存储在每个训练检查站四次(重量,EMA和两个亚当瞬间):大约每个检查站8GB.

blocks.en: 4  Sinks, Scratch Tokens and Registers
blocks.zh: 4个信封、切片托肯和登记册

blocks.en: This part of the work started as debugging. To understand failures we render the attention of the action tokens over the three cameras for every step of a rollout. For the warm-started 2025 model these maps were nearly useless: the same few cells lit up in all three cameras, in every frame of every episode (episode-mean maps correlate at 0.97, Figure 4 , left).
blocks.zh: 这部分工作开始于调试. 为了了解失败 我们让三台相机上 的动作信号引起注意 对于温暖开始的2025年模型来说,这些地图几乎是无用的:在所有三个相机中点出相同的几组电池,在每个相机插出的每一集的相框中(集图-意图相通于0.97,图4,左).

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Raw attention of the action tokens over the three cameras (left wrist, right wrist, head). Left: the warm-started 2025 model on turning_on_radio ; the same lattice of cells lights up in all cameras and frames, regardless of content. Right: the 2026 model at step 60k, after inserting registers, scratch tokens and sinks, on make_microwave_popcorn ; the attention follows the popcorn bag that the robot reaches for. The color scales differ (left: 98th percentile of image tokens, right: absolute, saturating at 4 × \times uniform).

blocks.en: The cause was the pretrained SigLIP position embeddings: a few cells have outlier norms (cell (12,1) has norm 313 against a mean of 22, mostly in one channel), so their tokens act as content-free “parking spots” for attention. The 12 hottest cells took 31.9% of all image attention, and cell (12,1) alone up to 29% of the right-wrist camera. This is the artifact described by Darcet et al. [ 24 ] in vision transformers and by Xiao et al. [ 25 ] in language models: the softmax needs somewhere to put excess attention, and the model repurposes some tokens for it, losing whatever information they carried. Beyond the lost information, it made the attention maps unreadable.
blocks.zh: 原因是预先训练的SigLIP位置嵌入:少数细胞有超标规范(细胞(12,1)有规范313,而平均值为22,大多在一个通道),因此它们的活字作为无内容的"停放点"来引起注意. 12个最热的细胞摄取了所有图像注意力的31.9%,仅细胞(12,1)就取取取了29%的右手相机. 这是由达克特等描述的文物. [24] 在视觉变压器和由萧等. [25] 在语言模型中:软马克斯需要去某个地方过度关注,模型重新为它设计出一些符号,失去了他们携带的任何信息. 除了丢失的信息,它使得注意力地图无法被读取.

blocks.en: We gave the model dedicated places for this at four levels: • SigLIP registers [ 24 ] : 8 learnable tokens inside the vision tower of each camera, without position embeddings. Their outputs pass through the same projection as the patch tokens and join the prefix (24 tokens), masked together with their camera. • VLM scratch tokens : 8 learnable tokens in the prefix, attended bidirectionally with the images. • Action-expert scratch tokens : 4 learnable tokens at the start of the suffix. • Attention sinks in every attention layer of both transformers: a virtual key with a learnable logit per query head [ 25 , 26 ] and, unlike gpt-oss, a learnable value per KV head, so attention parked on the sink still returns a learned vector instead of being discarded. We also added a linear projection per camera after the shared SigLIP encoder, initialized to the identity.

blocks.en: Surgery on a running training. The new tokens start neutral in the converted 2025 checkpoint, and fresh registers did not take over the sink role by themselves: early in the production run the outlier cells were unchanged and the registers had barely moved. We therefore moved the sinks explicitly, by parameter surgery on the running training: registers were initialized from the position embeddings of the hottest cells, each such cell’s position embedding was replaced by the mean of its neighbours, and the Adam moments of the edited parameters were reset. The surgery cost a brief loss bump that disappeared within a few hundred steps. After the surgery the attention maps follow the objects and the grippers (Figure 4 , right), and the attention-mass breakdown per token group became a useful diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 跑步训练上的外科手术. 新代币在被改造的2025年检查站起中性作用,而新鲜的登记册并没有自己接管下沉作用:生产初期运行出局的电池没有变化,登记册几乎没有移动. 因此,我们通过运行训练的参数外科手术,明确移动了汇:登记册从最热细胞的嵌入位置上初始化,每个这样的细胞的嵌入位置被邻居的平均值所取代,编辑参数的亚当瞬间被重置. 手术花费了一个短暂的损失起落 在几百步内消失。 手术后,注意力图跟随物体和抓取器(图4,右),每个符号组的注意力-质量分解成为有用的诊断.

blocks.en: We did not ablate these changes. The loss fully recovered after the surgery, so we do not think they hurt, but apart from making debugging easier we have no evidence that they improve the success rate. The numbers of registers, scratch tokens and sinks were chosen fairly arbitrarily.
blocks.zh: 我们没有减少这些变化。 手术后损失完全恢复, 所以我们不认为他们伤害, 但是除了让调试更容易, 我们没有证据表明他们提高了成功率。 登记册、划痕符号和汇的数量是相当武断的。

blocks.en: 7  Evaluation Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 7 评价基础设施

blocks.en: Evaluating 100 long tasks is expensive: an episode runs for up to tens of minutes of wall time, and a simulator takes 6–9 minutes to boot. Over the competition we ran around 9,000 evaluation episodes, about 100M environment steps or nearly 1,000 simulated hours; we saved each run with its provenance, diagnostics and restorable scene checkpoints, so we could compare models, inspect failures and start follow-up experiments from recorded states.
blocks.zh: 评估出100个长任务是昂贵的:一集跑出长达数十分钟的墙上时间,而模拟器需要6到9分钟才能启动. 在比赛中,我们运行了大约9000个评价事件,大约100M环境步骤或近1000个模拟小时;我们用其出处,诊断和可休息的场景检查点来节省每跑一次,这样我们可以比较模型,检查故障,并开始从有记录的州开始后续实验.

blocks.en: 7.1  Cloud infrastructure
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 云层基础设施

blocks.en: One record across clouds. We ran evaluations on local machines and two cloud platforms (RunPod, then Nebius); all runs were uploaded to one cloud bucket. A web portal indexes them automatically. Each run carries a manifest with its full provenance: code revision and diff, simulator and package versions, all evaluator and serving arguments, and the checksum of the served checkpoint, which links the run to a model registry.
blocks.zh: 一录过云. 我们在当地机器和两个云平台(RunPod,然后是Nebius)上进行了评估;所有运行都被上传到一个云桶上. 一个网络门户自动索引它们. 每次运行都携带一份带有其全部出处的明细表:代码修订和diff,模拟和包版本,所有评审员和服务参数,以及已运行的检查站的校验和,该检查站将运行与示范登记册连接.

blocks.en: Rich data. Recorded evaluations retain video and resource telemetry, plus per-step actions, observation and policy diagnostics, inference timing and BDDL goal progress. We save the robot and all initialized scene objects, including sleeping and non-task objects, at the start, every 30 steps, and at termination. This gives recovery experiments a restorable scene near a failure while limiting storage and evaluation slowdown; the tradeoff is that we can restore only saved steps. When an action creates new objects, as slicing does, we also save the scene description needed to rebuild them.
blocks.zh: 丰富数据. 记录的评价保留了视频和资源遥测,加上每步行动、观察和政策诊断、推断时间和BDDL目标进展。 我们保存机器人和所有初始化的场景物体, 包括睡眠和非任务物体, 在开始,每30个步骤,和结束。 这使得恢复实验在接近故障时有一个可恢复的场景,同时限制存储和评价减速;权衡的是我们只能恢复被保存的步骤. 当一个动作创造出新的物体,像切片一样,我们也保存重建它们所需的场景描述.

blocks.en: Restoration and review. These saved states can be loaded into a fresh simulator to replay part of a rollout or start a targeted recovery experiment. The portal lets people and coding agents find any model and episode, compare outcomes, watch the video next to the goal progress and leave timestamped comments. Agent rollouts (Section 9 ) use the same store and viewer (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 恢复和审查。 这些被保存的状态可以被装入一款新鲜的模拟器来重放部分推出或启动目标恢复实验. 门户网站让人和编码代理找到任何模型和插曲,比较结果,在目标进展旁边观看视频并留下有时间戳的评论. 代理推出(第9节)使用同一商店和取景器(图7.).

blocks.en: Scaling large evaluations. In the cloud, each GPU machine ran one policy server and six simulators, and a shared job queue, longest jobs first, kept all machines busy until the end, also when spot machines were preempted. A CPU-only head node requeued jobs after worker interruptions and uploaded completed runs. This mattered most for full evaluations: 100 tasks × \times 10 instances took about 20 hours on eight machines and cost about $300. Between full evaluations, a local driver sampled the least-measured tasks for each newly published checkpoint.

blocks.en: 7.2  Faster than real time on one GPU
blocks.zh: 7.2 在一个GPU上比实时快

blocks.en: Simulation is CPU-bound, so the gains came mostly from keeping the CPU busy with useful work: • Persistent simulators. Each simulator boots once and runs many episodes. The scene and random generators are saved at boot and restored before every instance (about 10 s instead of a 7.6-minute reboot), so each episode starts exactly like the first episode of a freshly started official evaluation. Without restoring the boot scene, changes outside the task scope—such as opened appliances, moved furniture, or created particles—can carry into the next episode. • Refilling environment slots. With several environments per simulator, a finished slot is refilled immediately instead of waiting for the slowest episode (the official vectorized evaluator wastes 45–48% of its steps this way); 2 × \times 5 slots gave 33% more useful steps per second than 2 × \times 1. • Thread caps for the simulator’s thread pools and disabled viewport updates: a 20-episode evaluation on our 12-core workstation went from 58.4 to 33.7 minutes (1.73 × \times ). • Hardware video encoding. Videos are encoded with the GPU’s NVENC encoder (H.264 for evaluation videos, HEVC for collected data) in a separate process, instead of on the CPU: at equal quality HEVC-NVENC took 2.3 s of CPU per 300 frames vs. 10.4 s for software AV1. • Native-resolution rendering. During development the cameras were rendered directly at the model’s 224 × \times 224 instead of the official full resolution: about 3 GB instead of 14–15 GB of GPU memory per simulator and 15% less wall time, with no measurable effect on success (28/50 vs. 30/50 paired episodes). The final submission renders at the official full resolution. • Batched inference. One policy server batches all environments; a batch of 10 takes 507 ms vs. 116 ms for one. With six simulators on one RTX PRO 6000 the machine simulates 33 environment steps per second against the 30 steps per second of simulated time: 1.11 × \times real time (Figure 8 ). This is an aggregate over the six simulators: each one alone runs at about 5.5 steps per second, so a single episode still takes longer than real time. Including boots and the uneven finish of a batch, a full fleet evaluation runs at about 0.86 × \times real time per GPU.

blocks.en: 8  What We Tried and Dropped
blocks.zh: 8 我们尝试和放弃

blocks.en: Scripted recovery in an agentic loop. A single failed grasp ends many episodes, and the demonstrations contain almost no recoveries. We developed a small declarative DSL in which a recovery is described as a sequence of primitives (approach, grasp, rotate, release, hand back to the policy) with tolerances, and used coding agents to write recipes for selected failure modes. Recoveries are generated from full simulator-state checkpoints of failed rollouts (Section 7 ), so every recovery episode starts exactly in a state the policy actually reached. On turning_on_radio the recovery data raised the specialist’s success rate from about 50% to 60–75%, i.e. roughly +0.1 Q for that task; on hanging_pictures it fixed the targeted failure but not the full task. Writing and validating recipes for new tasks took too long for the process to become autonomous, and at the scale of 100 tasks the expected gain for the final model was negligible.
blocks.zh: 在代理循环中被脚本回收. 一次失败的抓取结束了许多事件,示威几乎没有恢复。 我们开发出一个小的宣示DSL,其中恢复被描述为有容忍度的原始人序列(方法,抓取,旋转,放出,手回政策),并使用编码剂来为所选择的失败模式编写食谱. 恢复工作由完全模拟状态检查站产生,但启动失败(第7节),因此,每起恢复事件都在实际达到的政策状态下开始。 恢复数据将专家的成功率从50%左右提高到60-75%,即大约+0.1。 Q 用于此任务; 在悬浮图上, 它固定了目标失败而不是全部任务 。 编写和验证新任务的配方花费了太长的时间,进程才变得自主,在100个任务的规模上,最终模式的预期收益微不足道。

blocks.en: Manual DAgger. We also collected human corrections [ 33 ] by restoring failed rollouts and teleoperating from the failure state. For set_up_a_coffee_station_in_your_kitchen , we compared fine-tunes from the same checkpoint: one used the 200 task demonstrations, and the other sampled 70 reviewed teleop recovery segments (16,904 frames) at 5% of training samples. Mean Q was 0.367 with recoveries versus 0.267 without them (one-sided paired permutation p = 0.131 p=0.131 ), a difference that was not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 手动DAGER。 我们还通过恢复故障状态的启动和远程操作来收集人类矫正[33]。 对于设置_a_coffee_station_in_your_kitchen,我们比较了同一检查站的微调:一个使用了200个任务演示,另一个抽样了70个经过审查的远程恢复段(16,904帧),占培训样本的5%。 平均Q值为0.367,回收额为0.267,没有回收额则为0.267(单侧对接通式p=0.131p=0.131),这一差异在统计学上并不显著。

blocks.en: Astra-generated recoveries. In exploratory experiments, we found that nearly every policy failure could, with modest manual oversight, become a 15–30 s recovery task with a verifiable goal, such as satisfying one BDDL goal predicate or grasping or releasing an object. Astra solved all the mini-tasks we tested (100% success) in multi-turn sessions using the RoboICL [ 31 ] harness, suggesting a way to generate demonstrations for imitation learning.
blocks.zh: 由Astra产生的回收。 在探索性实验中,我们发现,在适度的人工监督下,几乎所有政策失败都可能成为15至30分的回收任务,具有可核查的目标,例如满足一个BDDL目标上游或抓住或释放一个物体。 Astra 利用 RoboICL [31] 的取用, 解决了我们在多回合中测试的所有小型任务(100%的成功),

blocks.en: Scripted recovery data and human corrections improved single tasks at small scale, and both were probably most useful for undertrained models: as the main run progressed, the base policy closed most of the gap on its own. We lacked the time and compute to scale recovery-data collection and fine-tuning to 100 tasks, or to distill Astra-generated trajectories into the policy, so we used Astra directly as a policy for difficult tasks (Section 9 ).
blocks.zh: 脚本的恢复数据和人修在小尺度上改进了单项任务,两者对于训练不足的模型来说都可能是最有用的:随着主跑道的进步,基础政策自行弥补了大部分差距. 我们缺乏时间和计算,无法将回收数据收集和精细调整到100项任务,或将Astra生成的轨迹提炼入政策,因此我们直接使用Astra作为困难任务的政策(第9节)。

blocks.en: 9  Agent Route: GPT-6 Astra
blocks.zh: 9 代理线路: GPT-6 Astra

blocks.en: We used GPT-6 Astra in two ways. In the first, the learned policy controls the robot and Astra takes over only for a short recovery. In the second, Astra controls the robot for the whole episode and starts from a saved copy of its own practice on that task. Only the second is in our final submission. We describe both, in the order in which we built them.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-6 Astra有两种方式. 在第一作中,所学的政策控制了机器人,而Astra只为短暂的恢复而接任. 在第二作中,Astra控制整个剧集的机器人,并从保存下来的本作任务练习的拷贝开始. 我们最后提交的只有第二份。 我们以我们建造它们的顺序来描述两者。

blocks.en: 9.1  Sol monitoring and bounded Astra intervention
blocks.zh: 9.1 国家 Astra 干预

blocks.en: In the intervention system, the learned policy stays in control. A GPT-6.1 Sol [ 30 ] monitor watches the three camera streams at 1 FPS and writes visual notes on the progress of the task. When the policy makes no progress for some time, for example when it fails the same grasp again and again or the robot falls, Sol writes a text description of a recovery, grounded in the task and in its notes. GPT-6 Astra then controls the robot for a bounded recovery: at most three interventions per episode, each of at most 900 actions. After the recovery, the learned policy continues from the new state.
blocks.zh: 在干预体系中,所学政策仍然控制着. 一个GPT-6.1 Sol [30] 监视器在1 FPS观看了三个相机流,并写下任务进度的可视化说明. 当政策在一段时间内没有取得进展时,例如当它一次又一次地失败同样的抓取或者机器人倒下时,Sol会写出一个恢复的文字描述,以任务及其注释为基础. GPT-6 Astra随后控制了机器人进行有限度的恢复:每集最多三次干预,每次最多900个动作. 收复后,从新州继续实行所学政策.

blocks.en: The length of the window that Sol looks back over mattered. We started with 10 seconds. This was too short, because the failures above develop over a longer time. We increased the window to 30 seconds, which Sol reviews every 10 simulated seconds.
blocks.zh: 索尔回头看的窗口长度是多少 我们从10秒开始。 这太短了,因为上述失败在较长的时间里发展。 我们把窗口增加到了30秒, 索尔每10个模拟秒评论一次。

blocks.en: We found no gain that we could attribute to the interventions. On one task, two monitored runs scored a Q of 0.67, against 0.17 for the learned policy alone, but one of the two runs contained no Astra action. The monitor also costs money when it does nothing. We did not submit this system.
blocks.zh: 我们没有发现任何好处,我们可以归因于这些干预。 在一项任务中,两项监测运行的Q分为0.67分,对0.17分,仅是学到的政策,但两项运行中有一项没有Astra行动。 监视器在无所作为时也要花钱. 我们没有提交这一制度。

blocks.en: 9.2  Historical failure comments as context
blocks.zh: 9.2 历史失败的评论作为上下文

blocks.en: We also used agents to review all our earlier rollouts and to annotate where the learned policy failed. For each task we collected these comments in one file, ANNOTATIONS.md , and gave it to the Sol monitor, so that it knew which failures to look for and could give Astra better guidance. We had to trim the files as training progressed, because the policy changed and its early failures stopped occurring.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用代理人来审查我们先前推出的所有项目,并在学到的政策失败的地方作出说明。 每一个任务,我们收集了这些评论 在一个文件, ANNOOTATIONS.md, 并把它给了Sol显示器, 这样它知道哪些失败了寻找, 并且可以给Astra更好的指导。 我们不得不随着培训的进展而修剪档案,因为政策已经改变,其早期失败已经停止。

blocks.en: The comments did not change the result. With them, the intervention system scored a Q of 0 on all 8 instances that we tested of two attachment tasks: attaching a camera to a tripod and making cabinet doors. The learned policy alone also scored 0 there. These tasks give no credit for a part that is almost attached, and after a recovery the control goes back to a policy that cannot do the precise step.
blocks.zh: 评论没有改变结果。 有了它们,我们测试过的所有8次干预系统都取得了0分的Q分数:在三脚架上安装相机和制造柜子门。 光是学习到的政策 也打出0分 这些任务对几乎附着的部分没有功劳,在回收后,控制又回到无法采取确切步骤的政策。

blocks.en: This work gave us the idea for the next step. The comments were feedback that we prepared before the episode, with offline compute. Astra could prepare such feedback for itself, from its own attempts at the task.
blocks.zh: 这项工作给了我们下一步的想法。 这些评论是我们在剧集前准备的反馈,并用离线计算. Astra可以从自己对这项任务的尝试中为自己准备这种反馈。

blocks.en: 9.3  Practice on training instances
blocks.zh: 9.3 培训实践

blocks.en: In the final design, Astra learns each task by practice before evaluation, in the spirit of automated research loops. A practice session is one long conversation of GPT-6 Astra, running in the Pi coding agent [ 32 ] , with one simulator. The simulator holds a training instance of the task, never an evaluation instance. It uses the same robot configuration, physics and cameras as the official evaluator, because earlier practice with a lighter robot base and different cameras did not transfer. Astra receives the task instruction, the goal definition, the human demonstrations of the task (camera images, robot state and actions) and the lessons that earlier practice sessions wrote down on other tasks.
blocks.zh: 在最终设计中,Astra本着自动研究循环的精神,在评价前通过实践来学习每项任务. 一个练习会是GPT-6 Astra的一段长对话,运行在Pi编码代理 [32],有一个模拟器. 模拟器举办任务培训,从未举办过评价会。 它使用与官方评价员相同的机器人配置,物理和相机,因为早期使用更轻的机器人基础和不同相机的练习没有转移. Astra接受任务指令,目标定义,任务的人演示(相机图像,机器人状态和行动)以及早期练习会记录的关于其他任务的经验教训.

blocks.en: The session follows a fixed loop. Astra first lists the hard parts of the task, such as grasps, presses, insertions, doors and hand-overs. It then practices one part at a time: it saves the scene just before the part, tries the part, and reads which goal conditions hold. When a part fails several times, Astra steps through two or three human demonstrations of the same part, compares the human motion with its own, changes what differs, restores the scene and tries again. When a part works, Astra writes a short recipe with the exact commands and measurements. After the parts, it runs the whole task from a fresh reset, without restores and within the official step limit, and writes a procedure for a later copy of itself.
blocks.zh: 会话遵循固定循环. Astra首先列出了任务的硬部分,如抓取,压取,插入,门和接取等. 然后它一次练习一个部分:它拯救了这个部分刚刚开始之前的场景,尝试了这个部分,并读取了哪些目标条件可以维持. 当一个部分多次失败时,Astra会通过同一部分的两到三个人类演示步骤,将人类运动与自己的运动进行比较,改变什么是不同的,恢复了场景并再次尝试. 当一个部分起作用时,Astra会写出一个简短的配方,其中包含精确的命令和测量. 零件后,从一新重置起运行整个任务,不恢复和在正阶限制内,并写出后发本的程序.

blocks.en: Reset, save, restore and goal feedback are privileged tools that exist only in practice. No weights are trained. What Astra learns stays in its conversation, which grew to 29–395 MB per task, and in its notes and recipes.
blocks.zh: 重置,保存,还原和目标反馈是只存在于实际中的特权工具. 没有重量训练。 Astra所学的东西留在了它的对话中,它增长到29–395 MB的每项任务,以及它的笔记和食谱中.

blocks.en: To test if practice transfers, we moved sessions to training instances that they had not seen, each with a different layout of the scene. The first attempt on a new instance used only the notes, without saved states, goal feedback or demonstrations. Over the final two days, 8 of 17 such first attempts succeeded. After a failed attempt, Astra studied the failure and practiced on the new instance. On cook_a_brisket , for example, the frozen session scored a Q of 0.33 and 1.0 with the official evaluator on two instances held out from practice. The learned policy scores 0.07 on this task.
blocks.zh: 为了测试是否进行练习转移,我们把课程转移到了他们从未见过的训练场景,每个场景布局不同。 对新实例的第一次尝试只使用了注释,而没有保存状态,目标反馈或演示. 在最后两天中,17起此类首次尝试中的8起成功。 在一次失败的尝试后,阿斯特拉研究了失败并在新实例上实践. 例如,在cook_a_brisket上,被冻结的会话得分为:Q为0.33分和1.0分,而官方评价员则在两次不实践的情况下得分。 所学政策对此任务评分为0.07分.

blocks.en: 9.4  Observation and motion tools
blocks.zh: 9.4 观察和运动工具

blocks.en: Practice and evaluation use the same three calls and the same controller (Figure 9 ). observe returns one image with the left wrist, head and right wrist camera views, and the robot state as text. xyz returns the position of every pixel in the robot frame, computed from the depth image of the official observation. act is the only motor command: one call is one full goal, for example a gripper pose, a gripper opening and a base motion. At every simulator step (30 Hz) a controller takes one inverse-kinematics step toward the goal and limits the joint and base speeds. It stops when the goal is reached, when the motion stalls or at a step limit, and returns a new image and what was achieved. Nothing reports contact or force, so Astra must judge from the images and the finger positions if a grasp holds.
blocks.zh: 练习与评价使用相同的3个调用和相同的控制器(图9. 观察返回一个图像,其中左手腕,头和右手腕相机视图,机器人状态为文本. xyz 返回机器人框架中每个像素的位置,由官方观察的深度图像来计算. 动作是唯一的运动指令:一个呼叫是一个完全的入球,例如抓取者姿势,抓取者开口和基运动. 在每一个模拟步骤(30 Hz)中,一个控制器向目标走出一个反相并限制关节和基节速度. 它在达到目标,运动停滞或步入限制时会停止,并返回新的图像和已经实现的东西. 没有报告接触或武力,因此Astra必须从图像和手指位置判断是否握有抓取.

blocks.en: We rebuilt these tools several times in the ten days before the deadline, and three iterations mattered most. First, we replaced short open-loop chunks of actions, after which Astra could not tell what had happened, with one goal per call and a loop that closes at every step. Free motions then reached their target within 0.83 mm, and a blocked motion is reported as stalled. Second, we replaced positions estimated from pixels, which missed grasps by centimeters, with positions from depth. Their worst error against the simulator was 1.06 μ \mu m over 3,598 samples. Third, long base motions made the robot fall, so we limited the base speed to 0.20 m/s and stop a motion when the measured velocity does not follow the command. In our experience, these iterations mattered more than the wording of the prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们在最后期限前十天重建了几次这些工具,三个迭代最为重要。 首先,我们替换了一小块行动,然后Astra无法说出发生了什么,每个呼叫都有一个目标,每个步骤都有一个圈子关闭。 然后自由运动在0.83毫米以内达到目标,据报道被阻滞的运动被停止. 第二,我们替换了从像素中估计到的位置,这些位置因厘米而失去抓取力,而从深度取出的位置。 他们与模拟器相比最差的误差是1.06 μ \ m,超过3,598个样本. 第三,长基运动使机器人倒地,因此我们把基速度限制在0.20米/秒,当所测速度不遵循指令时停止运动. 根据我们的经验,这些重复比提示的措辞更重要。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Observation and motion tools of the agent. Left: the three calls that Astra has, in practice and in evaluation. Middle: the controller executes one goal as one action per simulator step, and stops when the goal is reached, the motion stalls or the step limit passes. Right: the main iterations on the tools, each with the observation that confirmed it.
blocks.zh: 图9:该剂的观测和运动工具。 左:阿斯特拉在实际和评价中发出的三通电话. 中段:控制器将一入一入作为每个模拟步骤的一出动作执行,并在入球到达后停止,运动站或步限通过. 对:工具上的主要迭代,每个都带有证实它的观察.

blocks.en: 9.5  The final Astra policy
blocks.zh: 9.5 联合国 Astra的最终政策

blocks.en: At the end of practice we freeze the session: we save the conversation, the notes and the recipes, and do not change them again. In evaluation, the task of an episode decides which policy controls the robot. On 14 tasks, Astra controls it from the first step to the last. On all other tasks the learned policy plays alone. Unlike in the intervention system, control does not pass back and forth.
blocks.zh: 在实践结束时,我们冻结会议:我们保存对话、注释和食谱,不再改变它们。 在评价中,一集的任务决定了哪个政策控制了机器人. 在14项任务上,Astra从第一步控制到最后一步. 在所有其他任务上,学到的知识政策是单独执行的。 与干预系统不同,控制不会前后相传.

blocks.en: Every agent episode starts from a fresh copy of the frozen session of its task (Figure 10 ), so nothing carries over from one episode to the next. The privileged tools are gone. Astra receives only the official observation: the head and wrist camera images with depth, and the robot state. It does not produce low-level actions. It writes short programs that call the tools of Section 9.4 : they look at the scene, measure positions from the depth images, and send one goal at a time, such as a gripper pose, a base motion or a gripper command. The controller converts each goal into one action per simulator step and returns the result together with a new image. While Astra thinks, the simulation waits.
blocks.zh: 每出代理剧集都从被冻结的任务会话(图10)的新鲜副本开始,所以没有任何东西从一集延续到下一集. 特权工具不见了 Astra只接收到官方观察:有深度的头和手腕相机图像,以及机器人状态. 它不会产生低级行动。 它写出一些简短的程序,将第9.4节的工具称为:他们查看现场,从深度图像中测量位置,并一次发出一个入球,如抓取者姿势,基运动或抓取者命令等. 控制器将每个入球转换成每个模拟器步骤的一个动作并连同新图像一起返回结果. 虽然阿斯特拉认为,模拟等待.

blocks.en: If the agent fails at runtime, the learned policy plays the rest of that episode. This happens after three consecutive answers that exceed the time limit for one query, after an API error, or when the session reaches its cost limit or the episode its wall-time limit. A motion that does not reach its goal is not such a failure: Astra receives the result and plans again.
blocks.zh: 如果代理在运行时失败,学习政策会播放该集的其余部分. 这发生在连续三次超过一个查询时限的回答后,在API出错后,或者当会话达到其成本限制或剧集的墙上时间限制后. 一项没有达到目标的动议并非失败: Astra收到结果并再次计划.

blocks.en: We practiced 27 tasks and routed 14 of them to the agent. These are tasks on which the learned policy is weak (mean Q of 0.108) and on which either the agent did better in our tests or the policy scores about zero, so that there was little to lose. The agent route worked only one to two days before the final deadline. Practice, task selection and tuning were therefore short, and some tasks were routed without a complete successful practice run.
blocks.zh: 我们练习了27项任务 并将其中14项交给特工 这些是学习到的政策薄弱的任务(平均Q为0.108),而代理人在我们的测试中或政策评分中都做得更好,因此没有多少损失。 代理路线在最后期限前一到两天才运作. 因此,实践、任务选择和调试都很短,一些任务是在没有完全成功的做法运行的情况下进行的。

blocks.en: Across the 14 tasks, Astra’s mean Q was 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy alone (Figure 11 ). Due to time constraints, the public results contain only part of the agent episodes, 106 of 140. The agent is also slow and expensive: an agent episode took a median of 0.63 hours of wall time, about 17 times longer than real time, and cost tens of dollars in API fees.
blocks.zh: 在14项任务中,Astra的平均Q为0.639,而仅学习到的政策就为0.108(图11)。 由于时间所限,公测结果只收录了部分代理剧集,为140集中的106集. 代理机也缓慢而昂贵:一个代理机集花费了0.63小时的墙上时间中位数,比实时长了约17倍,花费了数十美元的API费.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : The Astra policy. Practice (left) uses training instances, resets, saved states and goal-predicate feedback to produce a frozen session, notes and recipes. Each agent-routed episode (right) forks that session. Astra plans goals from RGB-D and robot state; the controller uses robot-state feedback each simulator step and returns motion results, including stalls and step limits. Routing (bottom) selects Astra for 14 enabled tasks and the learned policy otherwise. Runtime errors or repeated query timeouts switch the rest of the episode to the learned policy; an unsuccessful motion alone does not trigger this fallback.
blocks.zh: 图10: Astra政策。 实践(左)使用培训实例,重排,被保存状态和目标前置反馈来生成被冻结的会话,注释和配方. 每集的代理节目(右) 叉那会话。 Astra计划目标来自RGB-D和机器人状态;控制器使用机器人状态反馈每个模拟器步骤并返回运动结果,包括摊位和步骤限制. 运行( 从下) 选择 Astra 执行 14 个启用的任务, 并选择学到的政策 。 运行时间出错或反复查询超时,将剧集其余部分切换为已学到的政策;单靠一个不成功的动作不会触发这种倒计时.

blocks.en: 10  Results
blocks.zh: 10 结果

blocks.en: We placed ninth overall and first among independent teams in the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge. On the public instances, our submission achieved a Q of 0.446 and a success rate of 27.3%. The organizers re-evaluated only the top-ranked submissions on the private test set; ours was not among them, so our score is self-reported from our own evaluation of instances 301–310 with the official evaluator.
blocks.zh: 在2026年的BEHAVIOR挑战赛中,我们把第9个整体和第一位排在独立团队中. 在公共场合,我们提交的申请达到0.446份,成功率为27.3%。 组织者只重新评价了私人测试集中排名最高的论文;我们的论文不在其中,因此我们的得分是从我们自己对301–310案例的评价中自报的。

blocks.en: π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone achieved a Q of 0.392. On 14 selected tasks that were hard for the policy, Astra achieved 0.639, compared with 0.108 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . The public submission included only part of the Astra results due to time constraints.
blocks.zh: 单是0.592的Q就达到了0.592。 Astra在14项选定任务中取得了0.639, 由于时间有限,公开提交的文件只包括部分Astra结果。

blocks.en: 10.1  Comparison with 2025

On the 50 tasks from 2025, Q rose from 0.260 to 0.371 (Figure 12 ). We think continued training, demonstrations from 50 additional tasks, model improvements, and bug fixes contributed to the gain. One checkpoint now covers all 100 tasks, compared with four checkpoints for 50 tasks last year (we did not have the resources to fine-tune multiple checkpoints). This gain came despite a 25% shorter episode time limit (1.5 × \times demonstration duration versus 2 × \times in 2025). The evaluations used different simulator versions, but we did not observe a meaningful performance difference between them.
blocks.zh: 在2025年的50个任务上,Q从0.260上升到了0.371(图12. 我们认为继续训练,50项额外任务的演示,模型改进,和bug修补都有助于收益. 现在有一个检查站负责全部100个任务,而去年有四个检查站负责50个任务(我们没有资源微调多个检查站)。 尽管短了25%的插曲时间(1.5x\时间演示时间与2025年的2xx时间),但还是取得了这一收益。 评估使用了不同的模拟版本,但我们没有观察到它们之间有意义的业绩差异。

blocks.en: 10.2  Comparison of failure modes
blocks.zh: 10.2 失败模式比较

blocks.en: On ten tasks reviewed in both years, full success rose from 20% for the 2025 submission to 36% for the 2026 learned policy. Figure 13 compares our failure-reason labels on these same tasks. The six labels assigned to 2026 failures in this sample mean: • Dexterity : Most often, the robot cannot pick up or place objects accurately. • Order : Wrong action sequence. Demonstrations solve each task in a particular order; after an earlier step is skipped, the policy may not know how to continue (e.g., how to open a fridge when both hands already hold objects). • Confusion : Seemingly random behavior, probably after the robot enters an out-of-distribution state. • Robot fell : The robot falls, commonly after stumbling over another object. • Reasoning : A locally nonobvious action is needed (e.g., regrasping a knife by the handle instead of the blade). • Whole-body coordination : Poor coordination of arms, torso, and base when squatting, reaching, or moving through a constrained space.
blocks.zh: 在这两年审查的10项任务中,完全成功率从2025年提交的20%上升到2026年的36%。 图13比较了我们在这些任务上的失败理由标签。 这个样本中分配给2026个失败的六个标签意味着: • Dexterity:最常发生的情况是,机器人无法接取或准确定位对象. • 命令:动作顺序错误。 演示以特定顺序解决了每个任务;在跳过更早的一步后,政策可能不知道如何继续(例如,在两手已经握住对象时如何打开冰箱). • 迷惑:看起来是随机行为,可能是在机器人进入出放状态后. 机器人坠落: 机器人掉下来了,通常在绊倒了另一个物体之后。 二. 支助 理由:需要当地不明显的动作(例如用刀柄来取出一把刀来代替刀刃). 二. 支助 整体协调: 武器、躯干和基地在蹲地、到达或穿过被限制的空间时协调不力。

blocks.en: Dexterity : Most often, the robot cannot pick up or place objects accurately.
blocks.zh: Dexterity : 最常见的是,机器人无法接取或准确定位对象.

blocks.en: Order : Wrong action sequence. Demonstrations solve each task in a particular order; after an earlier step is skipped, the policy may not know how to continue (e.g., how to open a fridge when both hands already hold objects).
blocks.zh: 顺序:动作顺序错误. 演示以特定顺序解决了每个任务;在跳过更早的一步后,政策可能不知道如何继续(例如,在两手已经握住对象时如何打开冰箱).

blocks.en: Confusion : Seemingly random behavior, probably after the robot enters an out-of-distribution state.
blocks.zh: 困惑:看起来是随机的行为,可能是在机器人进入外分流状态后.

blocks.en: Robot fell : The robot falls, commonly after stumbling over another object.
blocks.zh: 机器人坠落: 机器人掉下来了,通常在绊倒了另一个物体之后。

blocks.en: Reasoning : A locally nonobvious action is needed (e.g., regrasping a knife by the handle instead of the blade).
blocks.zh: 理由: 当地需要一种不明显的动作(例如用刀柄取出一把刀来代替刀刃).

blocks.en: Whole-body coordination : Poor coordination of arms, torso, and base when squatting, reaching, or moving through a constrained space.
blocks.zh: 整体协调: 武器、躯干和基地在蹲地、到达或穿过被限制的空间时协调不力。

blocks.en: The largest drop was in Order , from 13.0 to 6.7 attributed episodes. Robot fell decreased from 7.2 to 4.5 and Robot stuck from 2.8 to zero, while Dexterity remained high (29.8 versus 32.2).
blocks.zh: 降幅最大的是"秩序"(Order),从"13.0"到"6.7"的归属剧集. 机器人下降从7.2降至4.5,机器人卡住从2.8降至0,而Dexterity仍然很高(29.8对32.2).

blocks.en: Our review of the 2025 failures traced a substantial share of Order errors to demonstration tails, where the operator kept acting after task success. These frames were included in 2025 training even though the official evaluation ends at success. Our 2026 data loader cuts demonstrations at that point, removing a training signal that often led the 2025 policy to stop before completing the goal. Better aligned semantic stages may also have reduced sequencing errors, though we did not isolate their effect. Some Order failures remain: in boxing_books_up_for_storage , we verified that the stage was correct, yet the policy sometimes tried to pick up books before positioning the storage box. The policy failed to act according to the stage signal.
blocks.zh: 我们对2025年失败的回顾将秩序错误的相当一部分追溯到示范尾巴,操作员在任务成功后继续在那里行事。 这些框架包括在2025年的培训中,尽管正式评价已取得成功。 我们的2026个数据加载器在那个时候削减了演示,取消了一个经常导致2025年政策在实现目标前停止的培训信号. 更好的对齐语义阶段可能也减少了排序错误,尽管我们没有隔离它们的效果. 某些秩序失败仍然存在:在拳击_books_up_for_surverage中,我们验证了舞台是正确的,然而政策有时试图在定位存储盒之前取出书籍. 该政策未能按照舞台信号行事。

blocks.en: After switching to the 21-dimensional action representation, we observed that the robot was less likely to fall during deep squats. This representation matches the teleoperation controls, with torso translate and tilt replacing four independent torso joints, so the policy cannot command torso configurations absent from the demonstrations. The lower Robot fell count is consistent with that observation; the same change may also explain fewer Robot stuck failures. Dexterity labels did not decline, although in rollout reviews we observed better recovery from manipulation failures. As fewer episodes end at earlier sequencing or stability failures, more reach difficult manipulation steps, making dexterity limitations more visible.
blocks.zh: 在切换到21维的动作表现后,我们观察到机器人在深层蹲下时下降的可能性较小. 这种表示方式与远程操作控制相匹配,由躯干翻译和倾斜来取代四个独立的躯干关节,因此政策不能命令在演示中不进行躯干配置. 较低的机器人倒计时与这一观察是一致的;同样的变化也可能解释机器人卡住的故障减少的原因. Dexterity标签没有下降,尽管在推出审查中我们看到从操纵失败中恢复得更好。 由于较少的出场时间会以更早的顺序或稳定性故障而结束,更能达到困难的操纵步骤,使节能限制更加明显.

blocks.zh: 图13:2025年划界案和2026年经验教训政策共同分担的10项任务的人工说明失败原因。 当一集有多种原因时,它的计数在它们之间平均分配.

blocks.en: 10.3  Astra failure modes
blocks.zh: 10.3 阿斯特拉故障模式

blocks.en: On the selected tasks we reviewed, Astra struggled mainly with precise and efficient robot control. Pouring and other dynamic movements were difficult; placement lacked precision at times; Astra occasionally knocked objects out of place or moved the robot inefficiently. It could also loop when a task appeared complete but was not. We believe limited practice time explains most failures and that more practice could improve performance substantially.
blocks.zh: 关于我们审查过的选定任务,Astra主要通过精确有效的机器人控制来挣扎. Astra偶尔会把物体打出位置,或将机器人移动得效率低下。 当任务看似完整但却不是时,它也可能循环。 我们认为,实践时间有限是大多数失败的原因,而更多的实践可以大大地改善业绩。

blocks.en: 10.4  Emergent behavior
blocks.zh: 10.4 新出现的行为

blocks.en: Last year, we demonstrated that single-task policies made no attempt to recover, while the multi-task policy showed tentative attempts despite having no recovery demonstrations in its training data [ 1 ] . The 2026 policy, also trained without recovery examples, attempts recovery more often and with less hesitation; these attempts often let it continue the task successfully. Training across 100 tasks rather than 50 gave it a broader range of actions and situations to draw on when recovering. The policy also adapts familiar actions to the state it reaches, sometimes using the other arm or changing the action sequence after an earlier mistake (Figure 14 ). We find it promising that such goal-directed behavior can be learned from demonstrations alone across many tasks.
blocks.zh: 去年,我们表明,单一任务政策没有试图恢复,而多任务政策显示,尽管其培训数据中没有恢复示范[1],但只是尝试尝试。 2026年政策也经过培训,没有复原实例,更经常地尝试复原,而且不那么犹豫;这些尝试往往使复原工作得以成功进行。 培训涉及100个任务,而不是50个任务,使其在复原时能够借鉴更广泛的行动和情况。 该政策也根据它所达到的状态调整了熟悉的动作,有时会使用另一个臂来进行,或者在之前的错误发生后改变动作序列(图14. 我们发现,这种以目标为导向的行为有可能仅从许多任务的演示中得知。

blocks.en: (a) After dropping a beetroot, the policy efficiently picks it up and continues the task.
blocks.zh: (a) 国家 放弃蜂巢后,政策有效地拾取了蜂巢并继续执行任务.

blocks.en: (b) After putting the trash bin down too early, the policy places the can directly inside, skipping the usual step of picking up the bin.
blocks.zh: (b) 国家 将垃圾桶放倒太早后,政策将垃圾桶直接放入里面,跳出通常的取垃圾桶的步骤.

blocks.en: 11  Discussion
blocks.zh: 11 讨论情况

blocks.en: One policy on 100 tasks. After 2025 we assumed that our model was undertrained, and this year we trained one model for 200k steps, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025 it scores a Q of 0.371 against 0.260 for our winning 2025 submission (Section 10 ). The migration recipe (Section 3 ) let us continue from the 2025 checkpoint instead of starting from scratch. One checkpoint now covers all 100 tasks (we did not have the resources to fine-tune multiple checkpoints). We cannot attribute the gain to longer training alone: the policy also saw demonstrations from 50 additional tasks, and we made model improvements and bug fixes. The 2026 episodes had a shorter time limit; the evaluations used different simulator versions, but we did not observe a meaningful performance difference between them.
blocks.zh: 一项关于100项任务的政策。 2025年后,我们假设我们的模型训练不足,今年我们训练了一个200克步道的模型,大约一个越过了示威的211M帧. 在与2025年共同完成的50项任务中,它以0.371的Q比0.260的分数赢得2025年的提交(第10节)。 移徙办法(第3节)让我们从2025年检查站开始,而不是从零开始。 现在有一个检查站负责所有100个任务(我们没有资源对多个检查站进行微调)。 我们不能仅仅将这一收益归因于较长的培训:该政策还表现了50个额外任务,我们做了模型改进和错误修正。 2026集有更短的时间限制;评价使用了不同的模拟版本,但我们没有观察到它们之间的有意义的性能差异.

blocks.en: Recovery data helps a little, but we could not scale it. Extra recovery data had a small positive effect on undertrained models: scripted recoveries raised the success rate on turning_on_radio from about 50% to 60–75%, and human corrections raised Q on one task from 0.267 to 0.367, a difference that was not significant. We found no efficient way to collect such data for 100 tasks, and we did not test it on the final, better-trained model.
blocks.zh: 恢复数据稍有帮助,但我们无法加以扩大。 额外的恢复数据对训练不足的模型产生了小的积极影响:脚本回收将打开_on_radio的成功率从约50%提高到了60–75 % , 而人类修正将Q提升到一项任务从0.267提高到了0.367,这一差异并不显著。 我们没有找到有效的方法来收集100项任务的数据,我们也没有在最终的、训练有素的模型上测试这些数据。

blocks.en: A practicing LLM agent solves what the policy cannot, at a high price. After practicing on training instances in an automated research loop, GPT-6 Astra reached a mean Q of 0.639 across 14 selected tasks, compared with 0.108 for the learned policy on those tasks (Figure 11 ). On installing_smoke_detectors it scored 1.0, where the policy scores 0.10. This in-context learning from its own practice is the most striking result of our work. It is also expensive and slow: an agent episode took a median of 0.63 hours of wall time, about 17 times longer than real time, and tens of dollars in API fees, while six simulators served by the learned policy together run faster than real time on one GPU, and a full 1,000-episode evaluation costs about $300. We had the agent route working only one to two days before the deadline, so it is far from tuned. Making such agents cheaper and faster, or moving what they learn into the policy, remains open.
blocks.zh: 一个练习LLM代理以高价解决政策无法解决的问题. 在自动研究循环中进行训练后,GPT-6 Astra在14个选定任务中达到平均Q为0.639,而关于这些任务的学习政策则为0.108(图11)。 在安装_smoke_检测器时,它得分为1.0,其中政策得分为0.10. 这种从自身实践中学习的内在内容是我们工作最显著的结果。 其价格也昂贵而缓慢:一个代理剧集占用了0.63小时的墙上时间中位数,比实时长了约17倍,还有数十美元的API收费,而由所学政策的6个模拟器一起在一个GPU上运行的速度比实时快,一个1000集的完全评价费用大约为300美元. 我们在最后期限前一到两天就开通了特工路线,所以它远远没有调整。 使这些代理人更便宜、更快,或将他们所学到的东西纳入政策,仍然是开放的。
